verdict.rationale: Published tensor throughput is a fair axis for a GPU, but the evidence pack contains no TFLOPS or TOPS figure for the RTX 5090, let alone one with precision and sparsity stated. The closest item, docs-22, lists supported precisions (FP4 through TF32) alongside a relative "up to 3x higher throughput" claim. That is exactly the kind of bare marketing multiplier the story rejects, and community reviews offer only relative benchmarks rather than spec-sheet throughput.
